lessons.exercise: On your own project, produce Technical documentation and Changelog and ADR — so that: Repository docs updated with the change, ADR statuses current, changelog entries written.
lessons.prompt:
I'm working through "Document the Code & Decisions" (Build → Technical Documentation) on my own project. Act as my assistant: draft and check, I decide.

Goal: Keep the knowledge needed to understand and change the system next to the code and true to it.
Done looks like: Repository docs updated with the change, ADR statuses current, changelog entries written.

I'll attach or paste: Code change; ADRs; Pull request.

Work through these steps with me, one at a time:
1. Identify affected doc kinds (Diátaxis)
2. Update README, how-tos, explanation, reference → Technical documentation
3. Add the changelog entry; update ADR status → Changelog
4. Docs reviewed and build clean? (a decision — give me the options and a recommendation; I make the call)

Produce: Technical documentation; Changelog; ADR. Use clear headings I can paste into my document.

Before you finish, check it against: Docs changed with behaviour; One purpose per page; Changelog entry.

Ask me for anything you need instead of guessing. Keep it specific to my project.
